Sibling comparison (live workspace, read-only): projects/*/task.toml name/description/provenance/arena_slice for all 30+ tasks; projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline/instruction.md, task.toml, environment/instructions/hiring-rules.md (head), all tests/**/judge.toml criterion names; projects/threadline-chat/threadline-chat/tests/**/*.toml criterion names
evidence:
Authored for this product: instruction.md:1 opens as a recruiting team's ask ('Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day?') and frames the task around one product-specific tension - a shared pipeline board plus recruiter-candidate conversations under concurrent use (instruction.md:1-9). hireops_rules.md is domain-specific throughout: role table Recruiter/Hiring manager/Observer/Candidate (lines 14-19), six-stage board with Rejected aside and reopen-to-origin (42-53), per-job interview places (61-65), hiring-manager late-stage scope (70-72), stale-card 409 naming the colleague (77-80), bulk all-or-none and undo-while-untouched (87-100), unread/seen semantics where observer opens never count (151-166), drafts surviving session expiry (168-175), candidate wording table and staff-only data exclusion (177-194). Seed (environment/assets/seed_data.json) uses HireOps identities (@hireops.example, @candidates.example), candidate_status_labels and thread_page_size=30 matching rules. All 43 functional criteria use an hro_ prefix and map to these rules (e.g. hro_interview_full, hro_undo_conflict, hro_unread_scrolled_up, hro_seen, hro_drafts, hro_candidate_private). Grep of the frozen task for CHANGE_ME, pellmoor, threadline, bazaar, torquebay, colderwater/coldwater, gearvault, docketlight, 'vacanc' returned zero hits - no template residue or sibling nouns. task.toml description/difficulty_explanation/arena_slice/provenance are filled specifically (task.toml name 'turing/hireops-recruiting-operations', arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations', provenance 'Adapted from the supplied HireOps task...').

Not a nouns-swapped clone. Nearest sibling by domain is projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (recruiting). Shared generic concepts: ordered stages with no skipping, a capacity limit, an atomic multi-candidate action, stale-revision refusal. But the flows and criteria differ materially: Pellmoor centres on interview panels and 1-5 scoring, versioned assessments invalidated by panel changes, offer/hire vacancy capacity, reviewed batch offers with receipts and idempotent actor-scoped retries, and a d3 history-derived funnel (pellmoor criteria e.g. panel_change_invalidates_entire_assessment, exact_derived_funnel, successful_retry_replays_one_result, batch_lost_response_recovers_original_operation_and_live_view). HireOps has none of panels/scores/assessment versions/funnel/receipts; instead it grades manual intra-stage ordering shared across users, interview-place capacity counted for bulk sets, undo of own last (bulk) move refused after any touch, optimistic move with put-back and focus retention, 15-second live updates that preserve typing/focus/open card/scroll, per-application candidate conversations with paged history, per-person unread, seen receipts, per-user per-browser drafts surviving sign-out, and a candidate-facing portal with relabeled statuses and leak exclusions. Pellmoor's stage rule also differs (backstep allowed only one stage, rejected/withdrawn terminal) vs HireOps (one step either way, rejection reopenable to origin). Second nearest, threadline-chat, overlaps only on generic messaging mechanics (pagination preserving position, per-user unread); it is a Slack-style channel workspace (channels, DMs, threads, reactions, pins, mentions, webhooks, presence) and its criteria names share no flows with HireOps' board, undo, candidate isolation or seen-by-candidate rules. No sibling combines a kanban recruiting board with candidate-facing messaging. Criterion-by-criterion, no HireOps criterion is a renamed copy of a sibling criterion.

Fits the suite plan: the suite (projects/*) is a set of distinct full-stack Node/Express/SQLite business and game products, one product per domain; HireOps occupies a recruiting-operations slot whose only other occupant (Pellmoor) exercises a different concern set (assessment/offer integrity vs. collaborative board + messaging). No explicit 'suite domain plan' document exists in the frozen rules or template (staged-task-contract.md:51 only shows arena_slice = "..."); per quality-checks.md:213 I applied the stated procedure of comparing sibling names and concepts.

Adversarial check: a nouns-swapped clone (e.g. Pellmoor with 'vacancy' renamed to 'job') would fail here because HireOps' criteria require conversations, drafts, seen marks, live non-disruptive refresh and candidate portal that Pellmoor's flows never produce; conversely a conforming HireOps build would not satisfy Pellmoor's panel/funnel criteria - the two tasks are not interchangeable.

Minor observation (not a defect for this row): arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' omits the stack prefix convention most siblings use (e.g. 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-...'); it is still task-specific and non-placeholder. Pellmoor and HireOps both being recruiting means the suite has two tasks in that domain; this is acceptable given disjoint flows, but a suite owner allocating domains may want to confirm the duplication of domain is intended.
